purpose: Persist product/schema identity mappings discovered during true-venue data-access research so future sessions do not repeat the same discovery work.

ose_jpx.important_guardrail: Do not infer a micro 9-digit suffix from vendor/J-Quants codes. Resolve from official Appendix 3, a current JPX issue master, or an official daily report before parser hard-coding.

nikkei_225_mini.rule: Use actual acquired manifest/official product file coverage for Stage A; do not impute missing dates.

nikkei_225_micro.rule: Opening date is not equivalent to availability of every minute-data source.

sgx.rights_guardrail: Do not bulk-download, automate, or persist SGX legacy raw market data while current non-display/retention rights remain unresolved. A public downloader proves technical existence, not current permission.
